page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top with page number 119 at top right. Main text in one column, boxed, with marginal notes in a right margin column beside the lower part of the text. Catchword line "istuc" at the foot right, page number 14 at foot (signature-like line below the text rule).

main_text.p: copi, orationem dominicam, tunsionem pectoris, aquam benedictam, & similia, sine quocunque alio motu bono, sufficere ad venialia remitten-da, ita nimium ab omni & pi-etate, & iustitia videtur abhor-rere, vt nobis necessum sit, ab his naturæ, imo peccati leno-nibus æternum dissentire: Ve-tus illa regula est, & æque pro-festo vera: Facilitas veniæ in-centiuum tribuit delinquendi: sed & (bone Deus!) quæ illis audiunt vulgo venialia? Ebri-etas, adulterium, irati hominis blasphemia, auaritia; quin & furari, mentiri, maledicere pa-rentibus (quanta flagitia?)Decr. 23. q. 4. est iniusta.Petr. Alagena Comp. Manual. Nauarri. pag. 91. p. 267. p. 140. p. 191. p. 352. p. 100. Adulteria, & alia leviora pec-cata. Pontifi-cale.

page.notes: Marginal notes on the right are partly faint; the readings of the reference numbers are approximate. The faint show-through text at the left edge and at the upper right is not transcribed.
